item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-62de17e047d57cc5","start_unit":183,"end_unit":183,"fact_summary":"On 3 May 2023, the UN Special Procedures communications database recorded information concerning the arrest, detention, and prosecution of journalist Shamsuzzaman Shams Zaman, and an investigation opened into editor Matiur Rahman of Prothom Alo, Bangladesh’s largest daily newspaper.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Falls within 2023 and concerns conduct during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns actions by Bangladeshi authorities during Sheikh Hasina’s premiership, but does not attribute the actions personally to Hasina or identify the responsible agency.","limitations":["The document reports information received and does not establish that the allegations were proven.","No details are provided on the legal basis, conditions, outcome, judicial review, remedy, or subsequent correction.","The source does not provide evidence about other 2023 dimensions of the listed questions."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is a broad OHCHR communications search page; only the Bangladesh communication dated 3 May 2023 was materially relevant to Sheikh Hasina during 2023.","The source contains no direct evidence for nuclear risk, international peace, economic wellbeing, social wellbeing, or personal integrity questions during the target period."]}
